needle temp dir for weave\")?;\n        let tmp_file = tmp_dir.join(format!(\"weave-{}.md\", std::process::id()));\n        std::fs::write(&tmp_file, prompt).context(\"failed to write weave prompt to telemetry.clone(),\n        );\n\n        // Create the extraction agent if configured.\n        let reflect_agent = config\n            .strands\n            .reflect\n            .extraction_agent\n            .as_ref()\n            .map(|agent_cmd| {\n                Box::new(reflect::CliReflectAgent::new(\n                    agent_cmd.clone(),\n                    config.strands.reflect.extraction_prompt_template.clone(),\n                )) as Box<dyn reflect::ReflectAgent>\n            });\n\n        let reflect = ReflectStrand::new(\n            config.strands.reflect.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"reflect\"),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            reflect_agent,\n        );\n\n        // Reconstruct heartbeat_dir for Splice (same path used by Mend).\n        let splice_heartbeat_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\").join(\"heartbeats\");\n        let runner_telemetry = telemetry.clone();\n\n        // VALIDATION: Warn loudly if Splice is enabled but report_workspace is unset.\n        // This is a critical configuration gap - without report_workspace, Splice will\n        // silently fail to create escalation beads, missing the entire point of detection.\n        if config.strands.splice.enabled && config.strands.splice.report_workspace.is_none() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                \"━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Splice strand is ENABLED but strands.splice.report_workspace is NOT SET!\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Worker failure and live-loop detection will NOT create escalation beads.\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 To fix, add to your ~/.config/needle/config.yaml:\\\n                 \\n\\\n                   strands:\\\n                     splice:\\\n                       report_workspace: /path/to/your/workspace\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Or set NEEDLE_STRANDS__SPLICE__REPORT_WORKSPACE=/path/to/workspace\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        let splice = SpliceStrand::new(\n            config.strands.splice.clone(),\n            splice_heartbeat_dir,\n            state_base.join(\"splice\"),\n            telemetry,\n        );\n\n        let knot = KnotStrand::new(config.strands.knot.clone(), runner_telemetry.clone());\n        StrandRunner {\n            strands: vec![\n                Box::new(pluck),\n                Box::new(mend),\n                Box::new(explore),\n                Box::new(weave),\n                Box::new(unravel),\n                Box::new(pulse),\n                Box::new(reflect),\n                Box::new(splice),\n                Box::new(knot),\n            ],\n            telemetry: runner_telemetry,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Run the waterfall, returning a `SelectOutcome` that carries the winning\n    /// candidate (if any) plus restart diagnostics.\n    ///\n    /// Returns the full `Bead` (including its workspace path) so the caller\n    /// can create the correct bead store for remote beads found by Explore.\n    /// The accompanying `String` is the name of the strand that produced the\n    /// candidate.\n    ///\n    /// When a strand returns `WorkCreated`, the waterfall restarts from Pluck.\n    /// A restart cap prevents infinite loops (e.g. a strand that always creates\n    /// work without producing a claimable bead).\n    pub async fn select(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>,\n    ) -> Result<SelectOutcome> {\n        const MAX_RESTARTS: u32 = 3;\n        let mut restarts = 0u32;\n        let mut restart_triggers: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        let mut strand_evaluations: Vec<StrandEvaluation> = Vec::new();\n\n        'waterfall: loop {\n            for strand in &self.strands {\n                let strand_name = strand.name().to_string();\n                let strand_span = tracing::info_span!(\n                    \"strand.{}\",\n                    strand_name,\n                    needle.strand.name = %strand_name,\n                );\n                let strand_enter = strand_span.entered();\n\n                let start = Instant::now();\n                let result = strand.evaluate(store).await;\n                let elapsed_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n\n                // Record strand evaluation result as span attribute.\n                let (result_str, should_record) = match &result {\n                    StrandResult::BeadFound(beads) => {\n                        let count = beads.len();\n                        (\n                            format!(\"{}({})\", strand_results::BEAD_FOUND, count),\n                            count > 0,\n                        )\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::WorkCreated => (strand_results::WORK_CREATED.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::NoWork => (strand_results::NO_WORK.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::Error(_) => (strand_results::ERROR.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::Skipped { reason } => {\n                        (format!(\"skipped({})\", reason), true)\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Split(_, _failure_count) => {\n                        (format!(\"{}({})\", strand_results::BEAD_FOUND, 1), true)\n                    }\n                };\n                tracing::Span::current().record(attrs::NEEDLE_STRAND_RESULT, &result_str);\n                tracing::Span::current().record(attrs::NEEDLE_STRAND_DURATION_MS, elapsed_ms);\n\n                // Set strand span status: Error for strand errors, Ok for all other results\n                // Note: Skipped is not an error - it's expected for roam-only workers\n                if matches!(result, StrandResult::Error(_)) {\n                    tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n                    tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", &result_str);\n                }\n\n                // Only record evaluations that produced meaningful results.\n                // Skip recording empty BeadFound results since they don't\n                // represent actual strand activity.\n                if should_record {\n                    strand_evaluations.push(StrandEvaluation {\n                        strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                        result: result_str.clone(),\n                        duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                    });\n                }\n\n                match result {\n                    StrandResult::BeadFound(beads) => {\n                        // Filter out beads that are in the exclusion set (e.g.\n                        // recently race-lost).  This prevents the waterfall from\n                        // immediately re-selecting a bead that just lost a claim\n                        // race to another worker.\n                        let original_count = beads.len();\n                        let filtered: Vec<Bead> = beads\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .filter(|b| !exclusions.contains(&b.id))\n                            .collect();\n                        let excluded_count = original_count.saturating_sub(filtered.len());\n\n                        // Record queue depth for the Pluck strand (after filtering).\n                        // This samples the current queue depth for the needle.queue.depth\n                        // observable gauge, which is measured at strand evaluation.\n                        // We report depth per priority level to enable filtered views.\n                        if strand_name == \"pluck\" {\n                            use std::collections::HashMap;\n                            let mut depths: HashMap<u8, u64> = HashMap::new();\n                            for bead in &filtered {\n                                *depths.entry(bead.priority).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                            }\n                            self.telemetry.record_queue_depth(depths);\n                        }\n\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"bead_found\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            candidates = filtered.len(),\n                            excluded = excluded_count,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand found candidates\"\n                        );\n                        if let Some(bead) = filtered.into_iter().next() {\n                            // Keep the strand span active through the bead lifecycle.\n                            // The span guard will be dropped when the bead lifecycle ends.\n                            return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                                bead: Some((bead, strand_name.clone())),\n                                waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                                restart_triggers,\n                                strand_evaluations,\n                                strand_span_guard: Some(strand_enter),\n                                split_failure_count: None,\n                            });\n                        }\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Split(bead, failure_count) => {\n                        let bead = *bead;\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"split\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            failure_count,\n                            \"strand triggered split for bead with excessive failures\"\n                        );\n                        return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                            bead: Some((bead, strand_name.clone())),\n                            waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                            restart_triggers,\n                            strand_evaluations,\n                            strand_span_guard: Some(strand_enter),\n                            split_failure_count: Some(failure_count),\n                        });\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::WorkCreated => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"work_created\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        restarts += 1;\n                        restart_triggers.push(strand_name.clone());\n                        if restarts > MAX_RESTARTS {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                max_restarts = MAX_RESTARTS,\n                                \"waterfall restart cap reached, continuing to evaluate remaining strands\"\n                            );\n                            // Do NOT return None — continue evaluating remaining strands\n                            // so every strand emits telemetry and the operator can see\n                            // why the worker is idle.\n                            continue;\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            restart = restarts,\n                            \"strand created new work, restarting waterfall\"\n                        );\n                        continue 'waterfall;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::NoWork => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"no_work\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand returned no work\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Skipped { reason } => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: format!(\"skipped({})\", reason),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            reason = %reason,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand skipped\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Error(e) => {\n                        if let Err(te) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"error\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %te,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            error = %e,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand error, continuing to next strand\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            // All strands evaluated without finding work or triggering a restart.\n            return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                bead: None,\n                waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                restart_triggers,\n                strand_evaluations,\n                strand_span_guard: None,\n                split_failure_count: None,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Return the names of all configured strands (for telemetry/debugging).\n    pub fn strand_names(&self) -> Vec<&str> {\n        self.strands.iter().map(|s| s.name()).collect()\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests   }\n        }\n\n        fn work_created(\n            name: &'static str,\n            count: std::sync::Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32>,\n        ) -> Self {\n            CountingStrand {\n fn name(&self) -> &str {\n            self.name\n        }\n\n        async fn evaluate(&self, _store: &dyn BeadStore) -> StrandResult {\n            self.count.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst);\n            if self.returns_work_created {\n                StrandResult::WorkCreated\n            } else {\n                StrandResult::NoWork\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[tokio::test]\n    async fn restart_cap_still_evaluates_remaining_strands() {\n        // When a strand repeatedly returns WorkCreated, the waterfall restarts.\n        // After MAX_RESTARTS, the remaining strands should still be evaluated\n        // so that operators see telemetry for every strand in the cycle.\n        let creator_count = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32::new(0));\n        let observer_a_count = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32::new(0));\n        let observer_b_count = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32::new(0));\n\n        let runner = StrandRunner::new(vec![\n            Box::new(CountingStrand::work_created(\n                \"creator\",\n                creator_count.clone(),\n            )),\n            Box::new(CountingStrand::no_work(\n                \"observer-a\",\n                observer_a_count.clone(),\n            )),\n            Box::new(CountingStrand::no_work(\n                \"observer-b\",\n                observer_b_count.clone(),\n            )),\n        ]);\n        let store = EmptyStore;\n        let exclusions = HashSet::new();\n        let outcome = runner.select(&store, &exclusions).await.unwrap();\n        assert!(outcome.bead.is_none());\n\n        // creator should have been evaluated MAX_RESTARTS + 1 =                      error = %e,\n                        \"failed to probe lock file\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    // ── Step 3: Dependency link repair ───────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Find open beads that have closed blockers and clean up the stale\n    /// dependency links.\n    ///\n    /// br does not automatically resolve dependency links on bead closure,\n    /// so a bead can remain blocked even after its blocker is closed.\n    async fn cleanup_stale_dependencies(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        summary: &mut MendSummary,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let all_beads = store.list_all().await?;\n\n        for bead in &all_beads {\n            // Only check open beads that have dependencies.\n            if bead.status != BeadStatus::Open || bead.dependencies.is_empty() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            for dep in &bead.dependencies {\n                // Only check \"blocks\" type dependencies where the blocker is closed.\n                if dep.dependency_type != \"blocks\" {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                if dep.status == \"closed\" {\n                    tracing::info!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        blocker_id = %dep.id,\n                        \"removing stale dependency link (closed blocker on open bead)\"\n                    );\n\n                    // Remove the stale dependency link.\n                    match store.remove_dependency(&bead.id, &dep.id).await {\n                        Ok(()) => {\n                            // Emit telemetry for the removed dependency.\n                            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendDependencyRemoved {\n                                bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                                blocker_id: dep.id.clone(),\n                            });\n                            summary.deps_cleaned += 1;\n                        }\n                        Err(e) => {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                blocker_id = %dep.id,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to remove stale dependency link\"\n                            );\n                            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendDependencyCleanupFailed {\n                                bead_id: bead.id.to_string(),\n                                blocker_id: dep.id.to_string(),\n                                error: e.to_string(),\n                            });\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    // ── Step 3.5: Dead worker registry cleanup ───────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Scan the worker registry and remove entries for dead PIDs.\n    ///\n    /// This proactive cleanup ensures that dead worker entries don't accumulate\n    /// in the registry. The registry's list() method already filters dead PIDs,\n    /// but that only happens when rate limit checks run. This step ensures\n    /// cleanup happens every mend cycle.\n    fn cleanup_dead_workers(&self, summary: &mut MendSummary) -> Result<()> {\n        // Read the raw registry file to find entries that need cleanup.\n        let raw_content = match std::fs::read_to_string(self.registry.path()) {\n            Ok(c) => c,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to read registry file\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        let raw_reg: crate::registry::RegistryFile = match serde_json::from_str(&raw_content) {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to parse registry file\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        for entry in &raw_reg.workers {\n            // Skip our own entry.\n            if entry.id == self.qualified_id {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Check if the PID is dead.\n            if crate::registry::is_pid_alive(entry.pid) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Dead worker found — deregister it.\n            match self.registry.deregister(&entry.id) {\n                Ok(()) => {\n                    tracing::info!(\n                        worker_id = %entry.id,\n                        pid = entry.pid,\n                        \"removed dead worker from registry\"\n                    );\n\n                    let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendWorkerDeregistered {\n                        worker_id: entry.id.clone(),\n                        pid: entry.pid,\n                    });\n\n                    summary.workers_deregistered += 1;\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        worker_id = %entry.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"failed to deregister dead worker\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    // ── Step 4: Agent log file cleanup ──────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Delete `.agent.jsonl` files in `log_dir` that are older than\n    /// `retention_days` and do not belong to a currently-executing bead.\n    ///\n    /// Also deletes logs from workers that processed 0 beads immediately,\n    /// regardless of age. This cleans up logs from workers that crashed\n    /// before processing any beads.\n    ///\n    /// Files are matched by the `.agent.jsonl` suffix. The bead ID is parsed\n    /// from the stem (`<worker>-<bead>`): a file is considered active if the\n    /// stem ends with `-<bead_id}` for any in-progress bead.\n    async fn cleanup_old_agent_logs(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        summary: &mut MendSummary,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.retention_days == 0 {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(&self.log_dir) {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    dir = %self.log_dir.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"mend: failed to read log directory for agent log cleanup\"\n                );\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Collect all .agent.jsonl paths first so we can bail early if none.\n        let agent_log_paths: Vec<PathBuf> = entries\n            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())\n            .map(|e| e.path())\n            .filter(|p| {\n                p.file_name()\n                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())\n                    .map(|n| n.ends_with(\".agent.jsonl\"))\n                    .unwrap_or(false)\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        if agent_log_paths.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        let cutoff = Duration::from_secs(u64::from(self.retention_days) * 86400);\n\n        // Build the set of currently in-progress bead IDs.\n        let in_progress_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = store\n            .list_all()\n            .await?\n            .into_iter()\n            .filter(|b| b.status == BeadStatus::InProgress)\n            .map(|b| b.id.as_ref().to_string())\n            .collect();\n\n        // Get the registry workers for zero-activity detection.\n        let registry_workers = self.registry.list()?;\n\n        for path in &agent_log_paths {\n            // Skip if this log belongs to an in-progress bead.\n            let stem = match path\n                .file_name()\n                .and_then(|n| n.to_str())\n                .and_then(|n| n.strip_suffix(\".agent.jsonl\"))\n            {\n                Some(s) => s.to_string(),\n                None => continue,\n            };\n\n            let is_active = in_progress_ids\n                .iter()\n                .any(|bead_id| stem == *bead_id || stem.ends_with(&format!(\"-{bead_id}\")));\n\n            if is_active {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    \"skipping agent log for in-progress bead\"\n                );\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Extract worker ID from stem. Format is \"{worker_id}-{bead_id}\".\n            // Worker IDs may contain dashes, so we try to find a match in the registry\n            // by checking if any registered worker_id is a prefix of the stem.\n            let worker_id = registry_workers\n                .iter()\n                .find(|w| {\n                    // Stem format: \"{worker_id}-{bead_id}\"\n                    // If worker_id is a prefix of stem followed by a dash, it's a match.\n                    stem.starts_with(&format!(\"{}-\", w.id))\n                })\n                .map(|w| w.id.clone());\n\n            // Check if this is a zero-activity worker log.\n            let is_zero_activity = match worker_id {\n                Some(ref id) => {\n                    // Found in registry — check beads_processed count.\n                    registry_workers\n                        .iter()\n                        .find(|w| &w.id == id)\n                        .map(|w| w.beads_processed == 0)\n                        .unwrap_or(true)\n                }\n                None => {\n                    // Worker not in registry — treat as zero-activity (crashed before registering).\n                    true\n                }\n            };\n\n            if is_zero_activity {\n                // Delete immediately regardless of age.\n                if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_file(path) {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        path = %path.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"mend: failed to remove zero-activity agent log\"\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                tracing::info!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    worker_id = ?worker_id,\n                    \"mend: removed zero-activity agent log\"\n                );\n                summary.zero_activity_logs_cleaned += 1;\n\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendZeroActivityLogCleaned {\n                    worker_id: worker_id.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string()),\n                    log_path: path.display().to_string(),\n                });\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Check file age for retention-based cleanup.\n            let age = match file_age(path) {\n                Some(a) => a,\n                None => continue,\n            };\n\n            if age <= cutoff {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_file(path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"mend: failed to remove stale agent log\"\n                );\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            tracing::info!(\n                path = %path.display(),\n                age_secs = age.as_secs(),\n                \"mend: removed stale agent log\"\n            );\n            summary.agent_logs_cleaned += 1;\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    // ── Step 4.5: Trace retention cleanup ───────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n    ///\n    /// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after trace_retention_failed_days\n    /// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after trace_retention_success_days, keep metadata only\n    fn cleanup_old_traces(&self, summary: &mut MendSummary) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.traces_dir.exists() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        match cleanup_traces(\n            &self.traces_dir,\n            self.trace_retention_failed_days,\n            self.trace_retention_success_days,\n        ) {\n            Ok(cleanup_summary) => {\n                summary.traces_pruned = cleanup_summary.traces_pruned;\n                summary.traces_cleaned = cleanup_summary.traces_deleted;\n\n                if cleanup_summary.traces_pruned > 0 || cleanup_summary.traces_deleted > 0 {\n                    let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendTraceCleanup {\n                        traces_pruned: cleanup_summary.traces_pruned,\n                        traces_deleted: cleanup_summary.traces_deleted,\n                    });\n\n                    tracing::info!(\n                        traces_pruned = cleanup_summary.traces_pruned,\n                        traces_deleted = cleanup_summary.traces_deleted,\n                        \"mend: cleaned up old traces\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: trace cleanup failed\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    // ── Step 4.75: Learning consolidation ───────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Clean up and consolidate workspace learnings.\n    ///\n    /// 1. Prune stale entries (>90 days without reinforcement)\n    /// 2. Consolidate if entries exceed max_learnings\n    fn cleanup_learnings(&self, summary: &mut MendSummary) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut learnings = match LearningsFile::load(&self.workspace) {\n            Ok(l) => l,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::debug!(error = %e, \"mend: no learnings file to clean up\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        let _original_count = learnings.entries().len();\n\n        // Step 1: Prune stale entries\n        match learnings.prune_stale() {\n            Ok(pruned) => {\n                if pruned > 0 {\n                    tracing::info!(pruned, \"mend: pruned stale learning entries\");\n                    summary.learnings_pruned = pruned as u32;\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: failed to prune stale learnings\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Step 2: Consolidate if over limit\n        if learnings.entries().len() > self.max_learnings {\n            match learnings.consolidate(self.max_learnings) {\n                Ok(removed) => {\n                    if removed > 0 {\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            removed,\n                            max_count = self.max_learnings,\n                            \"mend: consolidated learning entries\"\n                        );\n                        summary.learnings_consolidated = removed as u32;\n                    }\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: failed to consolidate learnings\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if summary.learnings_pruned > 0 || summary.learnings_consolidated > 0 {\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendLearningCleanup {\n                pruned: summary.learnings_pruned,\n                consolidated: summary.learnings_consolidated,\n            });\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    // ── Step 5: Database health check with auto-recovery ────────────────────\n\n    // ── Step 4.8: Idle worker flagging ─────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Flag workers that have been registered longer than `idle_timeout` with\n    /// zero beads processed. This helps identify workers that may have failed\n    /// to start, are stuck in dispatch, or have agent adapter problems.\n    ///\n    /// This is a warning/telemetry-only operation — idle workers are NOT\n    /// deregistered (they may be genuinely waiting for work).\n    fn flag_idle_workers(&self, summary: &mut MendSummary) -> Result<()> {\n        let workers = self.registry.list()?;\n\n        for worker in workers {\n            // Skip workers that have processed at least one bead.\n            if worker.beads_processed > 0 {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Calculate worker age from started_at.\n            let age = match Utc::now().signed_duration_since(worker.started_at).to_std() {\n                Ok(d) => d,\n                Err(_) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        worker_id = %worker.id,\n                        \"worker started_at is in the future, skipping idle check\"\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            let idle_timeout = Duration::from_secs(self.config.idle_timeout);\n\n            if age > idle_timeout {\n                let age_secs = age.as_secs();\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    worker_id = %worker.id,\n                    pid = worker.pid,\n                    age_secs,\n                    idle_timeout_secs = self.config.idle_timeout,\n                    \"flagging idle worker (0 beads processed for longer than idle_timeout)\"\n                );\n\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendIdleWorkerFlagged {\n                    worker_id: worker.id.clone(),\n                    pid: worker.pid,\n                    age_secs,\n                });\n\n                summary.idle_workers_flagged += 1;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    // ── Step 4.9: Rate limiter state cleanup ─────────────────────────────────────\n\n    /// Clean up rate limiter state files.\n    ///\n    /// - Remove token bucket files for providers no longer in config\n    /// - Reset token buckets with stale last_refill (> 1 hour old) to full capacity\n    fn cleanup_rate_limit_state(&self, summary: &mut MendSummary) -> Result<()> {\n        use crate::rate_limit::TokenBucket;\n\n        let rate_limits_dir = self.state_dir.join(\"rate_limits\");\n\n        let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(&rate_limits_dir) {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    dir = %rate_limits_dir.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"mend: failed to read rate_limits directory for cleanup\"\n                );\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        for entry in entries {\n            let entry = match entry {\n                Ok(e) => e,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            let path = entry.path();\n            let name = match path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()) {\n                Some(n) => n,\n                None => continue,\n            };\n\n            // Only consider JSON files (token bucket files).\n            if !name.ends_with(\".json\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Extract provider name from filename (e.g., \"anthropic.json\" -> \"anthropic\").\n            let provider = match name.strip_suffix(\".json\") {\n                Some(p) => p,\n                None => continue,\n            };\n\n            // Check if provider exists in config.\n            let provider_in_config = self.limits_config.providers.contains_key(provider);\n\n            if !provider_in_config {\n                // Provider no longer in config — remove the file.\n                let age_secs = match file_age(&path) {\n                    Some(age) => age.as_secs(),\n                    None => continue,\n                };\n\n                match std::fs::remove_file(&path) {\n                    Ok(()) => {\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            provider,\n                            path = %path.display(),\n                            age_secs,\n                            \"removed rate limit state file for provider not in config\"\n                        );\n\n                        let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendRateLimitCleaned {\n                            provider: provider.to_string(),\n                            age_secs,\n                        });\n\n                        summary.rate_limit_providers_removed += 1;\n                        summary.rate_limits_cleaned += 1;\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            provider,\n                            path = %path.display(),\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"failed to remove rate limit state file\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Provider is in config — check if last_refill is stale (> 1 hour old).\n            let content = match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {\n                Ok(c) => c,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::debug!(\n                        provider,\n                        path = %path.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"failed to read rate limit state file\"\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            let mut bucket: TokenBucket = match serde_json::from_str(&content) {\n                Ok(b) => b,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::debug!(\n                        provider,\n                        path = %path.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"failed to parse rate limit state file\"\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            let last_refill_age = match Utc::now()\n                .signed_duration_since(bucket.last_refill)\n                .to_std()\n            {\n                Ok(d) => d,\n                Err(_) => {\n                    tracing::debug!(provider, \"last_refill is in the future, skipping reset\");\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            const STALE_THRESHOLD: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3600); // 1 hour\n\n            if last_refill_age > STALE_THRESHOLD {\n                // Stale token bucket — reset to full capacity.\n                let age_secs = last_refill_age.as_secs();\n                bucket.tokens = bucket.capacity as f64;\n                bucket.last_refill = Utc::now();\n\n                match serde_json::to_string_pretty(&bucket) {\n                    Ok(json) => {\n                        if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&path, &json) {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                provider,\n                                path = %path.display(),\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to write reset rate limit state file\"\n                            );\n                            continue;\n                        }\n\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            provider,\n                            age_secs,\n                            capacity = bucket.capacity,\n                            \"reset stale rate limit state to full capacity\"\n                        );\n\n                        let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendRateLimitProviderReset {\n                            provider: provider.to_string(),\n                            age_secs,\n                        });\n\n                        summary.rate_limit_providers_reset += 1;\n                        summary.rate_limits_cleaned += 1;\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            provider,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"failed to serialize reset rate limit state\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Run `br doctor` to check database health. If issues are found,\n    /// escalate through the recovery pipeline:\n    ///\n    /// 1. `br doctor` (check only) → if warnings found:\n    /// 2. `br doctor --repair` → if fails:\n    /// 3. Full rebuild (rm .beads/beads.db + br sync --import + verify)\n    ///\n    /// If the full rebuild also fails, the JSONL itself may be corrupt.\n    async fn check_db_health(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        summary: &mut MendSummary,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        // Step 1: Probe with `br doctor` (no repair).\n        let check_result = store.doctor_check().await;\n\n        let needs_repair = match check_result {\n            Ok(report) => {\n                // Doctor succeeded. If there are warnings, escalate to repair.\n                !report.warnings.is_empty()\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                let msg = format!(\"{e:#}\");\n                if crate::bead_store::is_corruption_error(&msg) {\n                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"br doctor detected corruption\");\n                    true\n                } else {\n                    // Non-corruption error (e.g., br not found). Propagate.\n                    return Err(e);\n                }\n            }\n        };\n\n        if !needs_repair {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Step 2: Try `br doctor --repair`.\n        tracing::info!(\"database health check found issues, attempting repair\");\n        match store.doctor_repair().await {\n            Ok(report) => {\n                let warnings = report.warnings.len() as u32;\n                let fixed = report.fixed.len() as u32;\n                tracing::info!(warnings, fixed, \"br doctor --repair completed\");\n\n                let _ = self\n                    .telemetry\n                    .emit(EventKind::MendDbRepaired { warnings, fixed });\n\n                // Only mark as repaired if actual fixes were applied.\n                // If warnings persist without fixes, returning WorkCreated would\n                // cause an infinite restart loop without making progress.\n                if fixed > 0 {\n                    summary.db_repaired = true;\n                    return Ok(());\n                }\n\n                // If doctor_repair succeeded but warnings persist without fixes,\n                // escalate to full rebuild. This prevents repeated Mend cycles\n                // where each evaluation calls doctor_repair which returns the\n                // same unfixed warnings without making progress.\n                if !report.warnings.is_empty() {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        warnings,\n                        \"doctor --repair succeeded but warnings persist without fixes, escalating to full rebuild\"\n                    );\n                } else {\n                    // No warnings and no fixes - DB is clean, no work needed.\n                    return Ok(());\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"br doctor --repair failed, attempting full rebuild\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Step 3: Full rebuild — rm db + br sync --import + verify.\n        match store.full_rebuild().await {\n            Ok(()) => {\n                tracing::info!(\"database fully rebuilt from JSONL\");\n\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendDbRebuilt);\n\n                summary.db_rebuilt = true;\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::error!(\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"full database rebuild failed — JSONL may be corrupt\"\n                );\n                Err(e)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for MendStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"mend\"\n    }\n\n    #[tracing::instrument(\n        name = \"strand.mend\",\n        skip(self, store),\n        fields(\n            needle.strand.name = \"mend\",\n            needle.strand.result = tracing::field::Empty,\n            needle.strand.duration_ms = tracing::field::Empty,\n        )\n    )]\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore) -> StrandResult {\n        let start = std::time::Instant::now();\n        let mut summary = MendSummary::default();\n\n        // Check if the home bead store exists. If not, skip this strand.\n        // This distinguishes between \"no home store configured\" (expected for\n        // roam-only workers) and \"home store is broken\" (unexpected error).\n        if !store.has_valid_store() {\n            tracing::info!(\n                \"Home workspace has no .beads/ directory — skipping Mend strand \\\n                 (expected for roam-only workers)\"\n            );\n            return StrandResult::Skipped {\n                reason: \"no_home_store\".to_string(),\n            };\n        }\n\n        // Step 1: Stale claim cleanup via peer monitoring.\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_stale_claims(store, &mut summary).await {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: stale claim cleanup failed\");\n            return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));\n        }\n\n        // Step 1.5: Agent log file cleanup.\n        // Must run BEFORE orphaned in-progress cleanup so that logs for in-progress\n        // beads are preserved (they're still InProgress when we check).\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_old_agent_logs(store, &mut summary).await {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: agent log cleanup failed\");\n            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.\n        }\n\n        // Step 2: Orphaned in-progress bead recovery (registry-based).\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_orphaned_in_progress(store, &mut summary).await {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: orphaned in-progress cleanup failed\");\n            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.\n        }\n\n        // Step 2.5: Orphaned heartbeat file removal.\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_orphaned_heartbeats(&mut summary) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: orphaned heartbeat cleanup failed\");\n            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.\n        }\n\n        // Step 3: Orphaned lock file removal.\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_orphaned_locks(&mut summary) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: orphaned lock cleanup failed\");\n            return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));\n        }\n\n        // Step 4: Dependency link repair.\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_stale_dependencies(store, &mut summary).await {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: dependency cleanup failed\");\n            return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));\n        }\n\n        // Step 4.5: Dead worker registry cleanup.\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_dead_workers(&mut summary) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: dead worker cleanup failed\");\n            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.\n        }\n\n        // Step 5: Trace retention cleanup.\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_old_traces(&mut summary) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: trace cleanup failed\");\n            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.\n        }\n\n        // Step 5.5: Learning consolidation.\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_learnings(&mut summary) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: learning cleanup failed\");\n            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.\n        }\n\n        // Step 5.75: Idle worker flagging.\n        if let Err(e) = self.flag_idle_workers(&mut summary) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: idle worker flagging failed\");\n            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.\n        }\n\n        // Step 5.875: Rate limiter state cleanup.\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_rate_limit_state(&mut summary) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: rate limit state cleanup failed\");\n            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.\n        }\n\n        // Step 6: Database health check.\n        if let Err(e) = self.check_db_health(store, &mut summary).await {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"mend: database health check failed\");\n            // DB check failure is non-fatal — continue with the summary.\n        }\n\n        // Emit cycle summary telemetry.\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendCycleSummary {\n            beads_released: summary.beads_released,\n            locks_removed: summary.locks_removed,\n            deps_cleaned: summary.deps_cleaned,\n            db_repaired: summary.db_repaired,\n            db_rebuilt: summary.db_rebuilt,\n            agent_logs_cleaned: summary.agent_logs_cleaned,\n            zero_activity_logs_cleaned: summary.zero_activity_logs_cleaned,\n            traces_pruned: summary.traces_pruned,\n            traces_deleted: summary.traces_cleaned,\n            workers_deregistered: summary.workers_deregistered,\n            idle_workers_flagged: summary.idle_workers_flagged,\n            rate_limits_cleaned: summary.rate_limits_cleaned,\n        });\n\n        let result = if summary.did_work() {\n            tracing::info!(\n                beads_released = summary.beads_released,\n                locks_removed = summary.locks_removed,\n                deps_cleaned = summary.deps_cleaned,\n                db_repaired = summary.db_repaired,\n                db_rebuilt = summary.db_rebuilt,\n                agent_logs_cleaned = summary.agent_logs_cleaned,\n                traces_pruned = summary.traces_pruned,\n                traces_deleted = summary.traces_cleaned,\n                \"mend performed cleanup — restarting waterfall\"\n            );\n            StrandResult::WorkCreated\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\"mend found nothing to clean\");\n            StrandResult::NoWork\n        };\n\n        // Record result and duration on the span\n        let duration_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n        tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.strand.result\", format!(\"{:?}\", result));\n        tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.strand.duration_ms\", duration_ms);\n\n        result\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Helpers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Get the age of a file based on its modification time.\nfn file_age(path: &Path) -> Option<Duration> {\n    let metadata = std::fs::metadata(path).ok()?;\n    let modified = metadata.modified().ok()?;\n    SystemTime::now().duration_since(modified).ok()\n}\n\n/// Try to acquire an exclusive flock on a file (non-blocking).\n///\n/// Returns `Ok(Some(file))` if acquired, `Ok(None)` if held by another process.\nfn try_acquire_flock(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<std::fs::File>> {\n    use fs2::FileExt;\n\n    let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n        .read(true)\n        .write(true)\n        .open(path)?;\n\n    match file.try_lock_exclusive() {\n        Ok(()) => Ok(Some(file)),\n        Err(ref e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => Ok(None),\n        Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n//         body = body,\n197\t            labels = labels,\n198\t        )\n199\t    }\n200\t\n201\t    /// Parse the agent response into proposed alternatives.\n202\t    pub fn }\n238\t}\n239\t\n240\t#[async_trait::async_trait]\n241\timpl super::Strand for UnravelStrand {\n242\t    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n243\t        \"unravel\"\n244\t    }\n245\t\n246\t    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore) -> StrandResult {\n247\t        // Guard: disabled.\n248\t        if !self.config.enabled {\n249\t            tracing::debug!(\"unravel strand tracing::info!(\n292\t            human_beads = human_beads.len(),\n293\t            \"unravel strand: found human-labeled beads\"\n294\t        );\n295\t\n296\t        // Process beads with guardrails.\n297\t        let mut total_created = 0u32;\n298\t        let mut beads_processed = 0u32;\n299\t        let cooldown_hours = self.config.cooldown_hours as i64;\n300\t\n301\t        for }\n310\t\n311\t            // Guard: cooldown — skip recently analyzed beads.\n312\t            if state.is_in_cooldown(&bead.id, cooldown_hours) {\n313\t                tracing::debug!(\n314\t .await\n348\t            {\n349\t                Ok(r) => r,\n350\t                Err(e) => {\n351\t                    tracing::warn!(\n352\t                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n353\t Unravel strand: propose automated alternatives for human-blocked beads.\n//!\n//! When beads carry the \"human\" label (requiring a human decision before\n//! proceeding), Unravel dispatches an AI agent to propose workarounds that\n//! could be executed autonomously. Alternative proposals are created as\n//! child beads of the original human-labeled bead.\n//!\n//! **Guardrails:**\n//! - Opt-in only (disabled by default).\n//! - Max beads analyzed per run.\n//! - Max alternatives per bead.\n//! - 7-day cooldown per bead (already-analyzed beads are skipped).\n//! - Original human bead is never modified or closed.\n//!\n//! Depends on: `bead_store`, `config`, `telemetry`, `types`.\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\nuse crate::types::{Bead, BeadId, StrandResult};\n\n// ─── UnravelAgent trait ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Abstraction for agent invocation used by the Unravel strand.\n///\n/// Production implementations wrap the `Dispatcher`; tests use mocks.\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\npub trait UnravelAgent: Send + Sync {\n    /// Invoke an agent with the given prompt, returning its raw text response.\n    async fn propose_alternatives(&self, prompt: &str, workspace: &Path) -> Result<String>;\n}\n\n// ─── Proposed alternative (parsed from agent response) ──────────────────────\n\n/// An alternative approach proposed by the agent for a human-blocked bead.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ProposedAlternative {\n    pub title: String,\n    pub body: String,\n}\n\n// ─── Persistent state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Persisted state for the Unravel strand.\n///\n/// Tracks which beads have been analyzed and when, enforcing the cooldown.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct UnravelState {\n    /// Map of bead ID -> last analysis timestamp.\n    pub analyzed: HashMap<String, DateTime<Utc>>,\n}\n\nimpl UnravelState {\n    /// Load state from disk, returning default if file doesn't exist.\n    fn load(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {\n        match std::fs::read_to_string(path) {\n            Ok(data) => serde_json::from_str(&data)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to parse unravel state: {}\", path.display())),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(Self::default()),\n            Err(e) => {\n                Err(e).with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read unravel state: {}\", path.display()))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Persist state to disk.\n    fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to create state dir: {}\", parent.display()))?;\n        }\n        let data =\n            serde_json::to_string_pretty(self).context(\"failed to serialize unravel state\")?;\n        std::fs::write(path, data)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write unravel state: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Check if a bead is within the cooldown period.\n    fn is_in_cooldown(&self, bead_id: &BeadId, cooldown_hours: i64) -> bool {\n        match self.analyzed.get(bead_id.as_ref()) {\n            None => false,\n            Some(last) => {\n                let elapsed = Utc::now().signed_duration_since(*last);\n                elapsed.num_hours() < cooldown_hours\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record that a bead has been analyzed.\n    fn mark_analyzed(&mut self, bead_id: &BeadId) {\n        self.analyzed.insert(bead_id.to_string(), Utc::now());\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── UnravelStrand ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// The Unravel strand — proposes automated alternatives for human-blocked beads.\npub struct UnravelStrand {\n    config: UnravelConfig,\n    workspace: PathBuf,\n    state_dir: PathBuf,\n    agent: Box<dyn UnravelAgent>,\n    telemetry: Telemetry,\n}\n\nimpl UnravelStrand {\n    /// Create a new UnravelStrand.\n    ///\n    /// `state_dir` is the base directory for unravel state files\n    /// (e.g., `~/.needle/state/unravel/`).\n    pub fn new(\n        config: UnravelConfig,\n        workspace: PathBuf,\n        state_dir: PathBuf,\n        agent: Box<dyn UnravelAgent>,\n        telemetry: Telemetry,\n    ) -> Self {\n        UnravelStrand {\n            config,\n            workspace,\n            state_dir,\n            agent,\n            telemetry,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Compute the state file path for a workspace.\n    fn state_file_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        let hash = workspace_hash(&self.workspace);\n        self.state_dir.join(format!(\"{hash}.json\"))\n    }\n\n    /// Find beads with the \"human\" label from all beads in the store.\n    fn filter_human_beads(beads: &[Bead]) -> Vec<&Bead> {\n        beads\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|b| b.labels.iter().any(|l| l == \"human\"))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    /// Get existing child beads (unravel-proposal children) for a parent bead.\n    fn count_existing_children(bead: &Bead) -> u32 {\n        bead.dependencies\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|d| d.dependency_type == \"blocks\")\n            .count() as u32\n    }\n\n    /// Build the unravel prompt for a human-blocked bead.\n    ///\n    /// Uses `config.prompt_template` when set; otherwise falls back to the\n    /// built-in template.  Template variables: `{id}`, `{title}`, `{body}`,\n    /// `{labels}`.\n    fn build_prompt(&self, bead: &Bead) -> String {\n        let body = bead.body.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"(no description)\");\n        let labels = bead.labels.join(\", \");\n\n        if let Some(template) = &self.config.prompt_template {\n            return template\n                .replace(\"{id}\", bead.id.as_ref())\n                .replace(\"{title}\", &bead.title)\n                .replace(\"{body}\", body)\n                .replace(\"{labels}\", &labels);\n        }\n\n        format!(\n            \"## Human-Blocked Bead\\n\\n\\\n             **ID:** {id}\\n\\\n             **Title:** {title}\\n\\\n             **Description:**\\n\\\n             {body}\\n\\\n             **Labels:** {labels}\\n\\n\\\n             ## Task\\n\\n\\\n             This bead is blocked because it requires a human decision. \\\n             Propose automated alternatives that could accomplish the same \\\n             goal without human intervention.\\n\\n\\\n             For each alternative, provide:\\n\\\n             - **title**: concise description of the alternative approach\\n\\\n             - **body**: what needs to be done (actionable, an agent can execute it)\\n\\n\\\n             Constraints:\\n\\\n             - Alternatives must be fully automatable (no human decisions needed)\\n\\\n             - Each alternative should be a self-contained, actionable task\\n\\\n             - Propose only viable alternatives, not partial workarounds\\n\\n\\\n             Output a JSON array of objects with \\\"title\\\" and \\\"body\\\" fields.\\n\\\n             If no viable automated alternative exists, respond with: NO_ALTERNATIVES\",\n            id = bead.id,\n            title = bead.title,\n            body = body,\n            labels = labels,\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Parse the agent response into proposed alternatives.\n    pub fn parse_agent_response(response: &str) -> Result<Vec<ProposedAlternative>> {\n        let trimmed = response.trim();\n\n        // Check for NO_ALTERNATIVES sentinel.\n        if trimmed.contains(\"NO_ALTERNATIVES\") {\n            return Ok(vec![]);\n        }\n\n        // Try parsing as a JSON array directly.\n        if let Ok(alts) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<ProposedAlternative>>(trimmed) {\n            return Ok(alts);\n        }\n\n        // Try extracting JSON from markdown code fences.\n        let json_str = extract_json_block(trimmed).unwrap_or(trimmed);\n\n        // Try as array.\n        if let Ok(alts) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<ProposedAlternative>>(json_str) {\n            return Ok(alts);\n        }\n\n        // Try as object with \"alternatives\" field.\n        if let Ok(obj) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(json_str) {\n            if let Some(arr) = obj.get(\"alternatives\").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {\n                let alts: Vec<ProposedAlternative> = arr\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter_map(|v| serde_json::from_value(v.clone()).ok())\n                    .collect();\n                if !alts.is_empty() {\n                    return Ok(alts);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        anyhow::bail!(\"failed to parse agent response as proposed alternatives\")\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for UnravelStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"unravel\"\n    }\n\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore) -> StrandResult {\n        // Guard: disabled.\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            tracing::debug!(\"unravel strand disabled\");\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        // Check if the home bead store exists. If not, skip this strand.\n        // This distinguishes between \"no home store configured\" (expected for\n        // roam-only workers) and \"home store is broken\" (unexpected error).\n        if !store.has_valid_store() {\n            tracing::info!(\n                \"Home workspace has no .beads/ directory — skipping Unravel strand \\\n                 (expected for roam-only workers)\"\n            );\n            return StrandResult::Skipped {\n                reason: \"no_home_store\".to_string(),\n            };\n        }\n\n        // Load persistent state.\n        let state_path = self.state_file_path();\n        let mut state = match UnravelState::load(&state_path) {\n            Ok(s) => s,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to load unravel state, using defaults\");\n                UnravelState::default()\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Query all beads and filter for human-labeled ones.\n        let all_beads = match store.list_all().await {\n            Ok(beads) => beads,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"unravel strand: failed to list beads\");\n                return StrandResult::Error(crate::types::StrandError::StoreError(e.into()));\n            }\n        };\n\n        let human_beads = Self::filter_human_beads(&all_beads);\n        if human_beads.is_empty() {\n            tracing::debug!(\"unravel strand: no human-labeled beads found\");\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            human_beads = human_beads.len(),\n            \"unravel strand: found human-labeled beads\"\n        );\n\n        // Process beads with guardrails.\n        let mut total_created = 0u32;\n        let mut beads_processed = 0u32;\n        let cooldown_hours = self.config.cooldown_hours as i64;\n\n        for bead in &human_beads {\n            // Guard: max beads per run.\n            if beads_processed >= self.config.max_beads_per_run {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    max = self.config.max_beads_per_run,\n                    \"unravel strand: max beads per run reached\"\n                );\n                break;\n            }\n\n            // Guard: cooldown — skip recently analyzed beads.\n            if state.is_in_cooldown(&bead.id, cooldown_hours) {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"unravel strand: bead is in cooldown, skipping\"\n                );\n                self.telemetry\n                    .emit(EventKind::UnravelSkipped {\n                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                        reason: \"cooldown\".to_string(),\n                    })\n                    .ok();\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Guard: max alternatives per bead — check existing children.\n            let existing_children = Self::count_existing_children(bead);\n            if existing_children >= self.config.max_alternatives_per_bead {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    existing_children,\n                    max = self.config.max_alternatives_per_bead,\n                    \"unravel strand: bead already has max alternatives, skipping\"\n                );\n                state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let remaining_slots = self.config.max_alternatives_per_bead - existing_children;\n            beads_processed += 1;\n\n            // Build prompt and dispatch agent.\n            let prompt = self.build_prompt(bead);\n            let response = match self\n                .agent\n                .propose_alternatives(&prompt, &self.workspace)\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(r) => r,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"unravel strand: agent dispatch failed\"\n                    );\n                    state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            // Parse proposed alternatives.\n            let proposed = match Self::parse_agent_response(&response) {\n                Ok(p) => p,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"unravel strand: failed to parse agent response\"\n                    );\n                    state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            if proposed.is_empty() {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"unravel strand: no alternatives proposed\"\n                );\n                state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Create child beads as alternatives.\n            let mut created_for_this_bead = 0u32;\n            for alternative in &proposed {\n                // Guard: remaining slots for this bead.\n                if created_for_this_bead >= remaining_slots {\n                    break;\n                }\n\n                // Guard: max total created per run.\n                if total_created >= self.config.max_beads_per_run {\n                    break;\n                }\n\n                let child_title = format!(\"[Unravel] {} — {}\", bead.title, alternative.title);\n                let child_body = format!(\n                    \"## Alternative for: {}\\n\\\n                     Original bead: {id}\\n\\n\\\n                     {alt_body}\\n\\n\\\n                     ---\\n\\\n                     This is an automated alternative proposal created by the \\\n                     unravel strand. It is a child of the original human-blocked \\\n                     bead and can be executed independently.\",\n                    bead.title,\n                    id = bead.id,\n                    alt_body = alternative.body,\n                );\n                let labels: Vec<&str> = vec![\"unravel-proposal\"];\n\n                match store.create_bead(&child_title, &child_body, &labels).await {\n                    Ok(child_id) => {\n                        // Link child as blocking parent (child blocks original).\n                        if let Err(e) = store.add_dependency(&child_id, &bead.id).await {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                                child_id = %child_id,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"unravel strand: failed to add dependency\"\n                            );\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::info!(\n                                parent_id = %bead.id,\n                                child_id = %child_id,\n                                child_title = %child_title,\n                                \"unravel strand: created alternative child bead\"\n                            );\n                        }\n\n                        created_for_this_bead += 1;\n                        total_created += 1;\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            error = %e,\n                            title = %alternative.title,\n                            \"unravel strand: failed to create child bead\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Emit telemetry for this bead.\n            self.telemetry\n                .emit(EventKind::UnravelAnalyzed {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    alternatives_proposed: created_for_this_bead,\n                })\n                .ok();\n\n            state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n        }\n\n        // Save state.\n        if let Err(e) = state.save(&state_path) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"unravel strand: failed to save state\");\n        }\n\n        if total_created > 0 {\n            tracing::info!(\n                created = total_created,\n                \"unravel strand: created alternative beads for human-blocked beads\"\n            );\n            StrandResult::WorkCreated\n        } else {\n            tracing::info!(\"unravel strand: no new alternatives created\");\n            StrandResult::NoWork\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Production agent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Production `UnravelAgent` that invokes the configured AI agent via subprocess.\n///\n/// The agent binary is called with `--print` so it emits the response as plain\n/// text on stdout without tool-use side-effects.  The prompt is written to a\n/// temp file and fed via stdin redirection.\npub struct CliUnravelAgent {\n    /// Agent binary name or path (e.g., `\"claude\"`).\n    agent_cmd: String,\n}\n\nimpl CliUnravelAgent {\n    /// Create a new `CliUnravelAgent`.\n    ///\n    /// `agent_cmd` is the binary used for analysis (typically taken from\n    /// `config.agent.default`).\n    pub fn new(agent_cmd: String) -> Self {\n        CliUnravelAgent { agent_cmd }\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl UnravelAgent for CliUnravelAgent {\n    async fn propose_alternatives(&self, prompt: &str, workspace: &Path) -> Result<String> {\n        // Write the prompt to a temp file.\n        let tmp_dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(\"needle\");\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&tmp_dir)\n            .context(\"failed to create needle temp dir for unravel\")?;\n        let tmp_file = tmp_dir.join(format!(\"unravel-{}.md\", std::process::id()));\n        std::fs::write(&tmp_file, prompt).context(\"failed to write unravel prompt to temp file\")?;\n\n        // Build the shell command: cd into workspace, pipe prompt to agent.\n        let cmd = format!(\n            \"cd {} && {} --print < {}\",\n            workspace.display(),\n            self.agent_cmd,\n            tmp_file.display(),\n        );\n\n        let output = tokio::process::Command::new(\"bash\")\n            .arg(\"-c\")\n            .arg(&cmd)\n            .output()\n            .await\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to spawn unravel agent: {}\", self.agent_cmd))?;\n\n        // Always clean up the temp file.\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_file);\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            anyhow::bail!(\n                \"unravel agent exited with code {}\",\n                output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1)\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned())\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Extract a JSON block from markdown-fenced content.\nfn extract_json_block(text: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n    let start_markers = [\"```json\\n\", \"```json\\r\\n\", \"```\\n\", \"```\\r\\n\"];\n    for marker in &start_markers {\n        if let Some(start) = text.find(marker) {\n            let content_start = start + marker.len();\n            if let Some(end) = text[content_start..].find(\"```\") {\n                return Some(&text[content_start..content_start + end]);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n/// Compute a short SHA-256 hash of a workspace path (for state filenames).\nfn workspace_hash(workspace: &Path) -> String {\n    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n    hasher.update(workspace.display().to_string().as_bytes());\n    let result = hasher.finalize();\n    result\n        .iter()\n        .take(8)\n        .fold(String::with_capacity(16), |mut acc, b| {\n            use std::fmt::Write;\n            let _ = write!(acc, \"{b:02x}\");\n            acc\n        })\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests
